thesis.core: 2026H1 cash generation and dividend capacity remain resilient despite reported earnings pressure, so the thesis is not broken; however, at RMB96.45 the probability-weighted price value is roughly flat and expected 12-month total return including dividend carry is only about 4.6%, below the system's capital hurdle.
thesis.variant_wedge: The reported revenue/profit decline overstates operating deterioration because VAT classification changes create comparability noise and operating cash flow improved sharply; the investable issue is opportunity cost rather than solvency or franchise impairment.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: 2026H1 revenue RMB538.0bn, attributable net profit RMB78.9bn, EBITDA RMB173.6bn, operating cash flow RMB114.9bn, interim dividend RMB2.51/share; normalize 2026E EPS at bear/base/bull RMB5.85/6.20/6.65.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: H1 EPS was RMB3.64; scenarios normalize VAT comparability noise, legacy communications pressure, application/information-service growth, cash conversion and ongoing AI/cloud investment.

catalysts: Comparable-basis core service revenue stabilizes and application/information-service growth reaccelerates.
AI/cloud/compute investments translate into measurable incremental profit and ROIC rather than only capex intensity.
Operating cash flow and free-cash-flow improvement persists through the second half.
Dividend growth remains intact while payout sustainability and balance-sheet strength are preserved.
kill_thesis: Comparable-basis core service revenue continues to contract without offsetting digital-service growth.
EBITDA decline persists while AI/cloud capex fails to generate acceptable returns.
Dividend policy or dividend-paying capacity is reduced materially.

sources.title: 中国移动2026年半年度报告

source_quality_note: Financials and dividend are from the filed 2026 interim report; 2026-09-22 close is reconciled to public historical market data. Scenario EPS, multiples, probabilities and dividend carry are analytical assumptions.
